verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ לִבְנֵי־ קֹ֬רַח מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃ אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ בְּאָזְנֵ֬ינוּ שָׁמַ֗עְנוּ אֲבוֹתֵ֥ינוּ סִפְּרוּ־ לָ֑נוּ פֹּ֥עַל פָּעַ֥לְתָּ בִֽ֝ימֵיהֶ֗ם בִּ֣ימֵי קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ liḇ·nê- qō·raḥ maś·kîl ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·’ā·zə·nê·nū šā·ma‘·nū ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·nū sip·pə·rū- lā·nū pō·‘al pā·‘al·tā ḇî·mê·hem bî·mê qe·ḏem
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Maskil of the sons of Korah We have heard with our ears O God our fathers have told us the work You did in their days in the days of old
verses.literalPt: Com os nossos ouvidos, temos ouvido; nossos pais nos têm contado o que fizeste nos seus dias, nos dias antigos.

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה׀ יָדְךָ֡ גּוֹיִ֣ם ה֭וֹרַשְׁתָּ וַתִּטָּעֵ֑ם תָּרַ֥ע לְ֝אֻמִּ֗ים וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh yā·ḏə·ḵā gō·w·yim hō·w·raš·tā wat·tiṭ·ṭā·‘êm tā·ra‘ lə·’um·mîm wat·tə·šal·lə·ḥêm
verses.literal: With Your hand You drove out the nations and planted our fathers there You crushed the peoples and cast them out
verses.literalPt: Por tuas próprias mãos, desapossaste as nações e os plantaste a eles. Afligiste os povos e a eles os estendeste largamente.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֪א בְחַרְבָּ֡ם יָ֥רְשׁוּ אָ֗רֶץ וּזְרוֹעָם֮ לֹא־ הוֹשִׁ֪יעָ֫ה לָּ֥מוֹ כִּֽי־ יְמִֽינְךָ֣ וּ֭זְרוֹעֲךָ וְא֥וֹר פָּנֶ֗יךָ כִּ֣י רְצִיתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō ḇə·ḥar·bām yā·rə·šū ’ā·reṣ ū·zə·rō·w·‘ām lō- hō·wō·šî·‘āh lā·mōw kî- yə·mî·nə·ḵā ū·zə·rō·w·‘ă·ḵā wə·’ō·wr pā·ne·ḵā kî rə·ṣî·ṯām
verses.literal: For it was not by their sword that they took the land their arm did not bring them victory . . . It was by Your right hand Your arm and the light of Your face because You favored them
verses.literalPt: Pois não foi pela sua espada que se apossaram da terra, nem foi o seu braço que os salvou; mas a tua destra, e o teu braço, e a luz do teu rosto, porque os favoreceste.

verses.original: אַתָּה־ ה֣וּא מַלְכִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים צַ֝וֵּ֗ה יְשׁוּע֥וֹת יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh- hū mal·kî ’ĕ·lō·hîm ṣaw·wêh yə·šū·‘ō·wṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: You . . . are my King O God who ordains victories for Jacob
verses.literalPt: Tu é que és meu rei, ó Deus. Ordena as salvações de Jacó.

verses.original: בְּ֭ךָ צָרֵ֣ינוּ נְנַגֵּ֑חַ בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ֗ נָב֥וּס קָמֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵā ṣā·rê·nū nə·nag·gê·aḥ bə·šim·ḵā nā·ḇūs qā·mê·nū
verses.literal: Through You we repel our foes through Your name we trample our enemies
verses.literalPt: Com o teu auxílio, derrubaremos os nossos adversários. Em teu nome, calcaremos aos pés os que se levantam contra nós.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א בְקַשְׁתִּ֣י אֶבְטָ֑ח וְ֝חַרְבִּ֗י לֹ֣א תוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō ḇə·qaš·tî ’eḇ·ṭāḥ wə·ḥar·bî lō ṯō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî
verses.literal: For I do not trust in my bow nor does my sword . . . save me
verses.literalPt: Pois não confiarei no meu arco, nem me salvará a minha espada.

verses.original: כִּ֣י ה֭וֹשַׁעְתָּנוּ מִצָּרֵ֑ינוּ וּמְשַׂנְאֵ֥ינוּ הֱבִישֽׁוֹתָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî hō·wō·ša‘·tā·nū miṣ·ṣā·rê·nū ū·mə·śan·’ê·nū hĕ·ḇî·šō·w·ṯā
verses.literal: For You save us from our enemies You put those who hate us to shame
verses.literalPt: Mas tu nos salvaste dos nossos adversários e cobriste de vergonha os que nos odeiam.

verses.original: בֵּֽ֭אלֹהִים הִלַּלְ֣נוּ כָל־ הַיּ֑וֹם וְשִׁמְךָ֓׀ לְעוֹלָ֖ם נוֹדֶ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: bê·lō·hîm hil·lal·nū ḵāl hay·yō·wm wə·šim·ḵā lə·‘ō·w·lām nō·w·ḏeh se·lāh
verses.literal: In God we have boasted all day long . . . and Your name we will praise forever Selah
verses.literalPt: Em Deus é que temos gloriado continuamente e ao teu nome sempre daremos graças. (Selá)

verses.original: אַף־ זָ֭נַחְתָּ וַתַּכְלִימֵ֑נוּ וְלֹא־ תֵ֝צֵ֗א בְּצִבְאוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- zā·naḥ·tā wat·taḵ·lî·mê·nū wə·lō- ṯê·ṣê bə·ṣiḇ·’ō·w·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: But You have rejected and humbled us You no longer go forth with our armies
verses.literalPt: Mas, agora, nos lançaste fora, e nos expuseste à ignomínia; e não sais com os nossos exércitos.

verses.original: תְּשִׁיבֵ֣נוּ אָ֭חוֹר מִנִּי־ צָ֑ר וּ֝מְשַׂנְאֵ֗ינוּ שָׁ֣סוּ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: tə·šî·ḇê·nū ’ā·ḥō·wr min·nî- ṣār ū·mə·śan·’ê·nū šā·sū lā·mōw
verses.literal: You have made us retreat . . . from the foe and those who hate us have plundered us
verses.literalPt: Fazes-nos dar as costas aos nossos adversários, e os que nos odeiam despojam-nos à vontade.

verses.original: תִּ֭תְּנֵנוּ כְּצֹ֣אן מַאֲכָ֑ל וּ֝בַגּוֹיִ֗ם זֵרִיתָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: tit·tə·nê·nū kə·ṣōn ma·’ă·ḵāl ū·ḇag·gō·w·yim zê·rî·ṯā·nū
verses.literal: You have given us up as sheep to be devoured You have scattered us among the nations
verses.literalPt: Entregaste-nos como ovelhas para alimento e, por entre as nações, nos espalhaste.

verses.original: תִּמְכֹּֽר־ עַמְּךָ֥ בְלֹא־ ה֑וֹן וְלֹ֥א־ רִ֝בִּ֗יתָ בִּמְחִירֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: tim·kōr- ‘am·mə·ḵā ḇə·lō- hō·wn wə·lō- rib·bî·ṯā bim·ḥî·rê·hem
verses.literal: You sell Your people for nothing no profit do You gain from their sale
verses.literalPt: Vendes por nada o teu povo; não lucras com o preço dele.

verses.original: תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ חֶ֭רְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ לַ֥עַג וָ֝קֶ֗לֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: tə·śî·mê·nū ḥer·pāh liš·ḵê·nê·nū la·‘aḡ wā·qe·les lis·ḇî·ḇō·w·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors a mockery and derision to those around us
verses.literalPt: Pões-nos por opróbrio aos nossos vizinhos, por escárnio e zombaria aos que nos rodeiam.

verses.original: תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ מָ֭שָׁל בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם מְנֽוֹד־ רֹ֝֗אשׁ בַּל־ אֻמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: tə·śî·mê·nū mā·šāl bag·gō·w·yim mə·nō·wḏ- rōš bal- ’um·mîm
verses.literal: You have made us a byword among the nations a laughingstock . . . among the peoples
verses.literalPt: Pões-nos por provérbio entre as nações, por menear de cabeça entre os povos.

verses.original: כָּל־ הַ֭יּוֹם כְּלִמָּתִ֣י נֶגְדִּ֑י וּבֹ֖שֶׁת פָּנַ֣י כִּסָּֽתְנִי׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hay·yō·wm kə·lim·mā·ṯî neḡ·dî ū·ḇō·šeṯ pā·nay kis·sā·ṯə·nî
verses.literal: All day long . . . my disgrace is before me and shame has covered my face
verses.literalPt: Durante o dia todo, está diante de mim a minha ignomínia, e me cobriu a vergonha do meu rosto,

verses.original: מִ֭קּוֹל מְחָרֵ֣ף וּמְגַדֵּ֑ף מִפְּנֵ֥י א֝וֹיֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: miq·qō·wl mə·ḥā·rêp̄ ū·mə·ḡad·dêp̄ mip·pə·nê ’ō·w·yêḇ ū·miṯ·naq·qêm
verses.literal: at the voice of the scorner and reviler because of the enemy bent on revenge
verses.literalPt: à voz do que afronta e do que blasfema, à vista do inimigo e do vingador.

verses.original: כָּל־ זֹ֣את בָּ֭אַתְנוּ וְלֹ֣א שְׁכַחֲנ֑וּךָ וְלֹֽא־ שִׁ֝קַּ֗רְנוּ בִּבְרִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- zōṯ bā·’aṯ·nū wə·lō šə·ḵa·ḥă·nū·ḵā wə·lō·ši- šiq·qar·nû biḇ·rî·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: All this has come upon us though we have not forgotten You . . . or betrayed Your covenant
verses.literalPt: Tudo isso é vindo sobre nós; contudo, não nos temos esquecido de ti, nem temos sido infiéis à tua aliança.

verses.original: לֹא־ נָס֣וֹג אָח֣וֹר לִבֵּ֑נוּ וַתֵּ֥ט אֲשֻׁרֵ֗ינוּ מִנִּ֥י אָרְחֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- nā·sō·wḡ ’ā·ḥō·wr lib·bê·nū wat·têṭ ’ă·šu·rê·nū min·nî ’ā·rə·ḥe·ḵā
verses.literal: Our hearts have not turned back . . . our steps have not strayed from Your path
verses.literalPt: O nosso coração não tem voltado atrás, nem do teu caminho têm declinado os nossos passos,

verses.original: כִּ֣י דִ֭כִּיתָנוּ בִּמְק֣וֹם תַּנִּ֑ים וַתְּכַ֖ס עָלֵ֣ינוּ בְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḏik·kî·ṯā·nū bim·qō·wm tan·nîm wat·tə·ḵas ‘ā·lê·nū ḇə·ṣal·mā·weṯ
verses.literal: But You have crushed us in the lair of jackals You have covered us . . . with deepest darkness
verses.literalPt: para nos teres esmagado onde habitam os chacais e nos teres coberto da sombra da morte.

verses.original: אִם־ שָׁ֭כַחְנוּ שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וַנִּפְרֹ֥שׂ כַּ֝פֵּ֗ינוּ לְאֵ֣ל זָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’i·mō·šā- šā·k̲aḥ·nû šêm ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū wan·nip̄·rōś kap·pê·nū lə·’êl zār
verses.literal: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god
verses.literalPt: Se nos esquecemos do nome do nosso Deus ou estendemos as nossas mãos a um Deus estranho,

verses.original: הֲלֹ֣א אֱ֭לֹהִים יַֽחֲקָר־ זֹ֑את כִּֽי־ ה֥וּא יֹ֝דֵ֗עַ תַּעֲלֻמ֥וֹת לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō ’ĕ·lō·hîm ya·ḥă·qār- zōṯ kî- hū yō·ḏê·a‘ ta·‘ă·lu·mō·wṯ lêḇ
verses.literal: would not God have discovered . . . since He knows the secrets of the heart
verses.literalPt: porventura, Deus não há de esquadrinhar isso? Pois ele conhece os segredos do coração.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עָ֭לֶיךָ הֹרַ֣גְנוּ כָל־ הַיּ֑וֹם נֶ֝חְשַׁ֗בְנוּ כְּצֹ֣אן טִבְחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘ā·le·ḵā hō·raḡ·nū ḵāl hay·yō·wm neḥ·šaḇ·nū kə·ṣōn ṭiḇ·ḥāh
verses.literal: Yet for Your sake we face death all day long . . . we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered
verses.literalPt: Mas, por amor de ti, somos entregues à morte continuamente, somos considerados como ovelhas para o matadouro.

verses.original: ע֤וּרָה׀ לָ֖מָּה תִישַׁ֥ן׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י הָ֝קִ֗יצָה אַל־ תִּזְנַ֥ח לָנֶֽצַח׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ū·rāh lām·māh ṯî·šan ’ă·ḏō·nāy hā·qî·ṣāh ’al- tiz·naḥ lā·ne·ṣaḥ
verses.literal: Wake up O Lord Why are You sleeping Arise Do not reject us forever . . .
verses.literalPt: Acorda! Por que dormes, Senhor? Desperta! Não nos enjeites para sempre.

verses.original: לָֽמָּה־ פָנֶ֥יךָ תַסְתִּ֑יר תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח עָנְיֵ֣נוּ וְֽלַחֲצֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh- p̄ā·ne·ḵā ṯas·tîr tiš·kaḥ ‘ā·nə·yê·nū wə·la·ḥă·ṣê·nū
verses.literal: Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression
verses.literalPt: Por que escondes o teu rosto e te esqueces da nossa miséria e da nossa opressão?

verses.original: כִּ֤י שָׁ֣חָה לֶעָפָ֣ר נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ דָּבְקָ֖ה לָאָ֣רֶץ בִּטְנֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî šā·ḥāh le·‘ā·p̄ār nap̄·šê·nū dā·ḇə·qāh lā·’ā·reṣ biṭ·nê·nū
verses.literal: For our soul has sunk to the dust our bodies cling to the earth
verses.literalPt: Pois a nossa alma está abatida até o pó, pegado à terra está o nosso ventre.

verses.original: ק֭וּמָֽה עֶזְרָ֣תָה לָּ֑נוּ וּ֝פְדֵ֗נוּ לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: qū·māh ‘ez·rā·ṯāh lā·nū ū·p̄ə·ḏê·nū lə·ma·‘an ḥas·de·ḵā
verses.literal: Rise up be our help Redeem us on account of Your loving devotion
verses.literalPt: Levanta-te em nosso auxílio e redime-nos por amor da tua benignidade.
